<USER_REQUEST>
You are adding P3 gameplay visuals to the Dungeon Haul client — making treasure, traps, and switches visible in the dev game scene.

START BY READING:
1. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/docs/components/presentation/DESIGN.md (§5 entity presenters)
2. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/docs/components/presentation/TASKS.md (C02-T08, C02-T09)
3. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/client/src/scenes/GameScene.ts — current P2 dev scene (colored rects)
4. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/packages/protocol/src/core.ts — TreasurePublic, TrapPublic, SwitchPublic, WorldSnapshot, HaulerPublic
5. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/client/src/net/sessionClient.ts — how snapshots are consumed

THIS IS A DEV PLACEHOLDER PASS — not final art. Use colored shapes/text like the existing hauler rects.

YOUR TASKS:

### C02-T08 — Treasure rendering
- Render free (world) treasures from `snapshot.treasures[]` as small colored diamonds/squares
  - Color by rarity: Common=white, Rare=blue, Unique=gold, Set=green
  - Size: ~12x12 px
  - Show defId as tiny text label below (optional, for debug)
- Render carried treasure indicators on haulers:
  - Small dots/squares stacked above the hauler rect
  - Show carry count as text if > 3 items
  - Top-of-stack (first in carry[]) should be visually distinct

### C02-T09 — Trap & switch rendering  
- Render traps from `snapshot.traps[]`:
  - Spikes: red triangles at trap position
  - Lightning zones: yellow/white flash rectangle when `active=true`, dim when inactive
  - Other kinds: gray placeholder
- Render switches from `snapshot.switches[]`:
  - Green circle when `pressed=false`, red circle when `pressed=true`
  - Small 'S' or 'H' text for regular vs heavy

### Also add to GameScene:
- Show stun visual on haulers: when `hauler.stunned === true`, draw stars/flashing border
- Show hauler carry count in the label text
- Update the HUD to show treasure counts

ALL rendering uses Phaser Graphics (this.gfx or this.add.graphics()) — no asset loading needed.
The existing GameScene already gets snapshots via this.session.latestSnapshot().

IMPORTANT: This is a dev-facing placeholder visualization. Keep it simple and functional. The real C-02 presentation with sprites/atlases comes later. Focus on making the P3 gameplay visible and debuggable.

Test by running: cd /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/client && pnpm run build (to check for type errors)
The dev server: cd /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/client && pnpm run dev
</USER_REQUEST>
